🚨 $RKLB Analysis: Potential Bull Trap Ahead 🚨

$RKLB could see one more rally of +15%, but I believe this may turn into a bull trap that catches retail investors off guard.

Looking at the weekly chart (image 2), a flip from 🟢 to 🔴 signals that institutional investors are likely pulling out.

Historically, short-term price action often pulls back to support (see daily chart, image 1). While it’s common to see a bounce and one more breakout attempt, these moves tend to make lower highs, as there isn’t enough institutional money on the larger timeframe to sustain further gains. 

This pattern frequently marks the top before a significant sell-off.

I hope I’m wrong, but consider this a cautionary note if you’re planning to buy this stock now.

This is not financial advice.

🚨 $UBER vs. $TSLA: Key Levels to Watch 🚨

While $TSLA has been breaking out massively, $UBER has been in a steep decline, leaving many on X wondering if the dip is a buy opportunity.

Currently, $UBER is approaching a smart money zone—a level where price typically bounces within a bullish structure.

However, I wouldn’t consider touching this until the BX trender flips green on the weekly chart. If the selling pressure persists, the next major level to watch is $50, which aligns with a stronger smart money zone.

For me, $50 is the long-term target area to consider buying or at least reassessing a long position.
